Our grand launch on 27th September, in collaboration with Musclebar Fitness Studio, marks the beginning of a new chapter.

Thank you, Pune, for showing up and being a part of our journey. This is just the beginning! ✨  #yasminkarachiwala #sopanbaug #newbranch #pilates #punecity".
